## Common Workflow Characteristics

- Constraint-aware reliability first (feasible-set tightening + staged protection logic).
- Decoupled modeling / evaluation / release architecture.
- Configuration-driven release workflow with staged validation and replay checks.
- User-facing observability (alerts, dashboards, and logs).
